verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Medusa serves a working llms.txt at docs.medusajs.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a description agents can consume, and Medusa also documents an official hosted MCP server and IDE/agent integration guidance for AI tools like Cursor. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of agents actually using llms.txt in practice, and broader agent-oriented doc formats beyond llms.txt/MCP.
